subject: Problem with packages when deploying app to shinyapps.io

messages.author: aae8e9f66c6ae74f
messages.subject: Problem with packages when deploying app to shinyapps.io
parts:
In common with several posters to this list, I am having a problem deploying an app (which works perfectly locally) because I get a message "Application depends on package "MASS" but it is not installed."

From what I read, it seems this is usually caused by not explicit mentioning a package dependency in the server code, but I have this explicitly coded (see snippet of server.R code below).

library(raster)
library(sp)
library(rgdal)
library(MASS)
library(maps)
library(moveHMM)
library(data.table)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsn)
library(leaflet)
library(magrittr)
library(shiny)


fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Mapping Elephants"),
  sidebarPanel(
    radioButtons(inputId = "ele", label = "Elephant ID", choices =  list("1" = 1, "2" = 2, "3" = 3),
                 selected = 1),
Specifically, I get the messages:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 329015...Error: 
* Application depends on package "MASS" but it is not installed.
   Please resolve before continuing.
* Application depends on package "maps" but it is not installed.
   Please resolve before continuing.
Execution halted
 
I have tried loading the packages in different sequence, in both server.r and io.r code (and in a separate apps.r code), etc., but can't seem to get around it. I must be missing something. (I would have provided logs, but I also can't find where they are, or how to get them...)

Any advice welcome - thanks!
Colin
